name: leaderboard-bars
title: Leaderboard Bars
description: Horizontal pass-rate bars with ±std whiskers, a gridded 0–100 axis, secondary metric columns, and an out-of-competition row below a hard rule.

meta.question: Who clears the bar, with what spread, and at what cost?
meta.whenToUse: Benchmark leaderboards where run-to-run spread (±std) and secondary costs (price/tokens/time) matter alongside the score; reference rows out of competition.
meta.antiUse: Single-metric rankings without spread or metric columns — use rank-bars; past ~12 rows the board outgrows a screen and labels stop scanning — use leaderboard-table.
